label: nyiso 16 transco-daily-gas
definition: Mechanism-D fix #1(a): DAILY Transco Z6 NY gas overlay. Keeper config + --gas-hub-basis-overlay --gas-hub-basis-daily, where the overlay's within-month shape is the REAL measured EIA NG Weekly Transco Z6 NY daily spot (scripts/fetch_transco_daily_spot.py -> transco_z6_ny_daily.csv, 674 trading days; daily monthly means reproduce the nyiso-15 monthly file to <$0.06, captured Henry Hub matches EIA RNGWHHD to $0.02). _nyiso_hub_daily_gas_prices scales that shape onto the monthly Iroquois-Z2 level, EXACTLY mean-preserving (annual gas burn/mix unchanged). VALIDATED positive (not a probe): does what the nyiso-15 monthly overlay could not -- Jan-2025 within-month smear fixed (+39.3 -> -1.97), 2025 summer under-price lifted (Jul -10 -> -1.1); monthly-LMP MAE 5.1/5.7/5.1 (keeper 8.0/4.3/6.3, monthly-15 5.6/5.9/7.5) -- best NYISO MAE on 2023 and 2025 and best average; and it RESTORES the 2025 net-interchange band the monthly overlay broke (117.5% OUT -> 109.8% IN, mean-preserving daily shape no longer pushes the annual import level out). Breaks NO volume band the keeper holds: every band where the keeper is in, daily is in (2025 interchange improved); every band where daily is out (2024/25 gas -9.8%/-6.2% vs EIA-930, 2023 interchange 74.2%) the keeper sits on the same EIA-930/923 basis floor by the same margin (keeper 2024 gas re-measured -8.8%). Keeper nyiso 11 STILL STANDS, gated on two non-daily-lever items: (1) the flat-annual Iroquois-Transco spread over-levels summer (Jul/Aug +10) -- fix #1(b), a real monthly Iroquois Z2 (EIA free has none), still data-blocked; (2) Dec-2024 -27.5 is the now-unmasked mechanism-B RCPF scarcity tail (actual RT $67.8), not mechanism D. Supersedes the keeper once #1(b) lands and B fills the winter tail. Zero tuning; every input sourced. See docs/nyiso-backcast-residual-attribution-2026-06.md section 4e.
